en: A vintage sepia-toned street view of a European city, showing cobblestone streets lined with brick buildings of two to three stories. In the distance a church or tower rises above the rooftops. The foreground shows narrow sidewalks and building facades close to the street. At the bottom, red printed caption text identifies the scene, and additional small printer's text appears along the margin. A shop sign on the right reads "OLOF DE VE…".
